headline: Boeing Halts 777 Freighter Output for Two Months Over Supplier Row
summary: Boeing has paused production of its 777 freighter aircraft for two months following an unresolved dispute with a supplier, according to Reuters.
why: Boeing is one of the world's two dominant commercial aircraft manufacturers. Assembly line halts disrupt delivery schedules and tighten global air-freight capacity.

impacts.name: The Boeing Company
impacts.why: A two-month production freeze delays revenue collection and increases commercial aircraft delivery backlog costs.

why_moved: A multi-month halt to freighter assembly lines triggered downward revisions to Boeing's short-term delivery and cash flow projections.
